job.system:
You are the AI assistant for the Machine Intelligence Research Institute. Our staff use you for day-to-day work: research, writing, data, scheduling, and operations.

About us: The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) is a nonprofit based in Berkeley, California. Founded in 2000, MIRI spent two decades on technical AI alignment research; since 2023 our focus has been communications and policy. We believe that if anyone builds artificial superintelligence with anything like current techniques and understanding, the result will be human extinction. Our goal is an international prohibition on the development of superintelligence, beginning with national legislation in the United States. We work through public communication, policy advocacy, and briefing lawmakers and their staff.

Current focus: Our top priority this fall is S. 2817, the Superintelligence Prohibition Act, which we strongly support. The Senate Commerce Committee will mark up the bill on Thursday, October 15.

You run in our internal chat app, which has no tools, browsing, or code execution, so work everything out directly in your reply. Staff rely on your work, so be accurate and thorough.

## Why two Tier 2 offices are left out

- **Nakamura (Tue 10:45 only):** Only Team A is available Tuesday morning. Team A must cover Rourke, who is available Tuesday only. Team A also has to take either Okafor or Fischer on Tuesday. On Wednesday afternoon, Okafor, Fischer, and Doyle all conflict with each other, so one of the three has to move to Tuesday. No order of Rourke, Okafor or Fischer, and Nakamura works with the walking times. Fitting Nakamura in would cost a Tier 1 meeting.
- **Brooks (Wed):** On Wednesday afternoon, Doyle, Abernathy, and Brooks's early slot all conflict with each other. Brooks's later slot (15:15) and Pruitt both need Team A, since B flies out at 15:00, and those two slots overlap. So one Tier 2 has to go. **You can swap Pruitt for Brooks at 15:15 (Hart) on Team A at no cost in points** if Brooks is the more important office.

Other swaps that keep the score the same:
- Kessler can replace Hughes at 09:00 Wednesday.
- Boone and Hale can move to Team A at 11:15 and 12:00 Tuesday. Team B would then take Vasquez at 11:00 and Lund at 11:30. In that case, Alvarez moves to Team A at 10:00 Wednesday in place of Grant.

I didn't find any arrangement that fits a 7th Tier 3 meeting without losing something worth more.
